description: Every countable linear order embeds into every nontrivial dense linear order, in particular into the rationals.
signature:
Order.embedding_from_countable_to_dense.{u_1, u_2} (α : Type u_1) (β : Type u_2) [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]
  [Countable α] [DenselyOrdered β] [Nontrivial β] : Nonempty (α ↪o β)
